reviews.text: it cost too much, but the game is VERY good. You got nps autobattler dudes with skills you can manually trigger, you got weapon upgrades, you got relics and skills. The game has it all. To me compared to other games in the same genre its priced too high, but it s in fact very good.

Idle & Incremental Lovers recommends No More Slimes! [i] Very fun slime/time killer with various layers of progression, traditional player aiming and an autobattler component. Quickly becomes braindead and chaotic, but sometimes that's what you need, right? [/i] + It has funny slimes, it's chaotic, it's "dopaminic", it's colorful, it's humorous, it's repetitive, it's braindead, all the ingredients of a good time waster! + In addition to the traditional upgrade tree, you get cards, relics, weapons and minions to help you murdering slimes. + The special powers of your minions are really powerful and satisfying. + Dev keeps improving the game and adding new contents. - Despite the various layers of progression, progression feels very linear. Resources needed to buy upgrades change, but upgrades are samey. - Dev should really put an epilepsy warning (flickering screen and flashing lights). - The ending is very anticlimatic (nothing happens!). Note that I haven't played the additional content that was just added today, so this may have changed. *What’s a slime’s favorite sport? Squash!* Found this review helpful? T'is very slimy 7/10 Not sure about the incremental part, but fun, in a way, cute as well. A semi-auto battler. Love all the different slimes. Lots to do too. See video for a little gameplay teaser
A solid mix of nodebuster-like and active gameplay. The different characters are fun, but overall I think the market had it's fair share of these kind of games. So a solid mixed on this one.
Its good but grindy! The game offers everything you need, weapons, auto battling chars, different loadouts, a nice progression until you hit iron ;()

Very fun slime/time killer with various layers of progression, traditional player aiming and an autobattler component. Quickly becomes braindead and chaotic, but sometimes that's what you need, right?
Somewhat respects your time. Cute slime-farming incremental, looks and feels fine, but progression drags - too grindy for me, fine if you like it slow.
Fox plays No More Slimes!! and likes raising chaos on the screen, engaging gameplay making you want to do more runs and cute, colorful visuals to sum it up.
Action-packed survivor-like with a massive skill tree, mercenary system, and weapon upgrades. Addictive slime-hunting!
